sanskrit_verse:
सवत्सारोमतुल्यानि युगान्य् उभयतो�ुखीम् ।
दातास्याः स्वर्गम् आप्नोति पूर्वेण विधिना ददत् ॥१.२०६
transliteration: savatsāromatulyāni yugāny ubhayatomukhīm | dātāsyāḥ svargam āpnoti pūrveṇa vidhinā dadat || 1.206
sph_interpretive_translation: One who gives a cow with its calf, equal in age and facing both directions, according to the prior established procedure, attains svarga.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the act of giving aligned with Dharma
Causation arises through intentional alignment with sacred procedure
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness of the act's spiritual consequence
Restoration logic operates through conscious participation in cosmic order
Consciousness alignment manifests via precise adherence to Vedic giving

supreme_court_application: In matters concerning spiritual merit attribution, the Supreme Court shall recognize acts performed in exact accordance with Vedic procedures as legally valid within the framework of sanatana dharma jurisprudence, granting recognition of svarga entitlement exclusively upon fulfillment of all specified conditions without symbolic substitution or cultural reinterpretation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that svarga arises solely from precise alignment with Vedic action; anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential causality where intent, form, and procedure jointly manifest result; proportional responsibility lies in complete execution; non-punitive reality rule affirms outcome as natural consequence, not imposed judgment.
